input.answer:
Regular self-serve gasoline was cheaper in Toronto in September 2026.

- Toronto, Ontario: 183.7 (cents per litre, the table's published units)
- Vancouver, British Columbia: 209.5 (same units)

Difference: 209.5 − 183.7 = 25.8 units. Toronto was 25.8 / 209.5 = 12.3% lower than Vancouver.

For context, in August 2026 Toronto was 170.3 and Vancouver 206.7 (gap of 36.4). Toronto rose 13.4 (183.7 − 170.3 = 13.4, +7.9%) while Vancouver rose 2.8 (209.5 − 206.7 = 2.8, +1.4%) over the month.

Source: Statistics Canada, Table 18-10-0001-01, Monthly average retail prices for gasoline and fuel oil, by geography (Regular unleaded gasoline at self service filling stations). The table's scalar factor is "units"; the values are as published and I have not converted them.
